description: Switch the visible basemap style. Returns { success, data: { basemap }, message? }.

basemap.description: Basemap type: dark=dark theme, satellite=satellite imagery, standard=standard, osm=OpenStreetMap, arcgis=ArcGIS streets, light=light theme, tianditu_vec=Tianditu vector, tianditu_img=Tianditu imagery, amap=Amap roads, amap_satellite=Amap satellite

sessionId.description: Target browser session ID for multi-browser routing (optional)

token.description: Token for providers requiring authentication (e.g. Tianditu)

url.description: Custom URL template with {x},{y},{z} placeholders. When provided, basemap param is ignored.

name: setBasemap
